stem:
Read this excerpt from lines 37 and 38 from the poem.

I don’t ask for a ticket and he doesn’t offer one.

What can the reader infer about the speaker based on the excerpt from these lines?

options.label: A
options.text: The speaker trusts the shoemaker to repair his shoe.

options.label: B
options.text: The speaker is confused why the shoemaker does not offer him a ticket.

options.label: C
options.text: The speaker thinks it would be insulting to ask for a ticket.

options.label: D
options.text: The speaker understands that his shoe is not difficult to repair.

visual_elements: Box containing text: I don’t ask for a ticket and he doesn’t offer one.
